@@ -23,7 +23,7 @@
 import struct
 import zipfile
 import zlib
-from typing import Callable
+from typing import Any, Callable
 from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
 
 import pandas as pd
@@ -748,3 +748,70 @@ def test_open_import_bundle_corrupt_member(
 
     assert excinfo.value.message == "Invalid or corrupted ZIP file"
     assert isinstance(excinfo.value.__cause__, cause)
+
+
+def _make_oversized_member_bundle() -> bytes:
+    """A bundle whose single member exceeds a lowered ZIPPED_FILE_MAX_SIZE."""
+    return _make_bundle()
+
+
+def _make_oversized_total_bundle() -> bytes:
+    """A bundle whose members together exceed a lowered ZIP_FILE_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE."""
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w") as bundle:
+        bundle.writestr("bundle/metadata.yaml", "version: 1.0.0\n")
+        bundle.writestr("bundle/databases/db.yaml", "version: 1.0.0\n")
+    return buf.getvalue()
+
+
+def _make_high_ratio_bundle() -> bytes:
+    """A bundle whose compress ratio exceeds the default ZIP_FILE_MAX_COMPRESS_RATIO."""
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as bundle:
+        bundle.writestr("bundle/metadata.yaml", "0" * 1024 * 1024)
+    return buf.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "make_bundle, config, message",
+    [
+        (
+            _make_oversized_member_bundle,
+            {"ZIPPED_FILE_MAX_SIZE": 10},
+            "Found file with size above allowed threshold",
+        ),
+        (
+            _make_oversized_total_bundle,
+            {"ZIP_FILE_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE": 20},
+            "Found total uncompressed size above allowed threshold",
+        ),
+        (
+            _make_high_ratio_bundle,
+            {},
+            "Zip compress ratio above allowed threshold",
+        ),
+    ],
+    ids=["member-size", "total-size", "compress-ratio"],
+)
+def test_get_contents_from_bundle_unsafe_zip(
+    app: Any,
+    make_bundle: Callable[[], bytes],
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    message: str,
+) -> None:
+    """
+    A bundle that fails the ZIP safety checks is bad user input and must raise
+    ``IncorrectFormatError`` (422) instead of a bare ``SupersetException`` (500).
+    """
+    from superset.commands.importers.exceptions import IncorrectFormatError
+    from superset.commands.importers.v1.utils import get_contents_from_bundle
+    from superset.exceptions import SupersetException
+
+    with patch.dict(app.config, config):
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(make_bundle())) as bundle:
+            with pytest.raises(IncorrectFormatError) as excinfo:
+                get_contents_from_bundle(bundle)
+
+    assert excinfo.value.status == 422
+    assert excinfo.value.message == message
+    assert isinstance(excinfo.value.__cause__, SupersetException)

 from io import BytesIO
 from pathlib import Path
 from typing import Any
-from zipfile import is_zipfile, ZipFile
+from zipfile import is_zipfile, ZIP_DEFLATED, ZipFile
 
 from pytest_mock import MockerFixture
 
@@ -300,6 +300,48 @@ def test_import_assets_corrupt_zip(
     }
 
 
+def test_import_assets_unsafe_zip(
+    mocker: MockerFixture,
+    client: Any,
+    full_api_access: None,
+) -> None:
+    """
+    Test that a ZIP failing the safety checks (here, a compress ratio above
+    ``ZIP_FILE_MAX_COMPRESS_RATIO``) returns a 422, not a 500.
+    """
+    buf = BytesIO()
+    with ZipFile(buf, "w", compression=ZIP_DEFLATED) as bundle:
+        bundle.writestr("bundle/metadata.yaml", "0" * 1024 * 1024)
+    buf.seek(0)
+    form_data = {
+        "bundle": (buf, "unsafe.zip"),
+    }
+    response = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/assets/import/", data=form_data, content_type="multipart/form-data"
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+    assert response.json == {
+        "errors": [
+            {
+                "message": "Zip compress ratio above allowed threshold",
+                "error_type": "GENERIC_COMMAND_ERROR",
+                "level": "warning",
+                "extra": {
+                    "issue_codes": [
+                        {
+                            "code": 1010,
+                            "message": (
+                                "Issue 1010 - Superset encountered an error while "
+                                "running a command."
+                            ),
+                        }
+                    ]
+                },
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+

Hello Community,

The Apache Superset team is pleased to announce that Superset
6.1.0 has just been released.

Apache Superset is a modern, enterprise-ready business intelligence web application.

The official source release:
https://downloads.apache.org/superset/6.1.0

The PyPI package:
https://pypi.org/project/apache_superset/6.1.0

The CHANGELOG for the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0/CHANGELOG/6.1.0.md

The instructions for updating to the release:
https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/6.1.0/UPDATING.md

If you have any usage questions or have problems when upgrading or
find any issues with enhancements included in this release, please
don't hesitate to let us know by sending feedback.
